verdict.rationale: Orama's first-party docs state that every Orama Cloud project ships with an automatically configured MCP server. Users copy its URL to connect ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP-capable assistants, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: documentation of the exposed MCP tools and auth model, MCP support for the open-source library (only Cloud is covered), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server that is automatically configured to interact with your project's data.
By copying the MCP Server URL, you can easily connect your Orama Cloud project to various AI assistants that support the MCP protocol.
you'll be able to interact with your data from different AI interfaces, including ChatGPT, Cursor, and many other
